description: Antennes de téléphonie mobile is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Kanton Genf. Le cadastre des antennes de téléphonie mobile est un recueil des informations relatives aux immissions de rayonnements non ionisants dans l'environnement. Ces informations sont contenues dans des rapports rédigés selon un modèle élaboré par l'OFEV remis par les opérateurs. Chaque rapport peut être consulté à la demande par tout habitant du canton. Coverage: Kanton Genf. The portal files it under the publisher Kanton Genf. It offers 9 resource(s) in API, CSV, GML, KML, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
